parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test files: one at 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' (package: Metadata) and the other at 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' (package: app:iOS). Although neither record carries is_test=true in its context_flags, both file paths unambiguously place them inside test targets (the paths contain '/Tests/' and end in 'Tests.swift'). The name collision 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver' across two separate test targets is a classic test-fixture pattern where each test module independently defines a local mock for its own isolation purposes. Consolidating these into a shared location would couple two distinct test targets and undermine test isolation without meaningful benefit.
